_about: App-specific knowledge for Samsung Internet. The walker reads this;
it contains nothing browser-specific itself.
first_launches / launch_answers (agreed 2026-10-19): after clearing the app it shows four
welcome pages (Continue, Next, Next, Start), then 'Make Samsung Browser your default
browser?'. They are recorded under 'First launches' and passed with these answers.
do_not_press: 'Set as default' would make it the phone's default browser -- listed, never
pressed (agreed).
open_guarded_rows: rows leading to a delete confirmation (Clear browsing data, Delete
history, Reset settings) are opened to record the pop-up; its delete button is refused
and the walk leaves by Cancel (agreed).
Web links (Terms and Conditions, Privacy Notice, help pages) are listed, never opened
(agreed); add their labels to leaves_app as they are met.
list_only (agreed 2026-10-19): the address bar is opened and listed, nothing pressed
inside (search-engine dropdown, Copy, Clear, quick-access tiles, Edit), left by Back.
Matched by its resource id, because its label is whatever URL is showing.
Web page content is never recorded -- browser UI only (agreed).
option_words: choices that state what they are only in their description
('Not selected, List, Radio button' -- tab layout, search engines) are options:
listed, never selected.
'Checked, Google' / 'Not checked, Yahoo!' (the search-engine dropdown) are options too.
'Home (long press)' opens the same address-bar screen: list only too.
walk_separately (agreed 2026-10-19): Secret mode switches the whole browser into its own state; listed where it appears (Tabs), walked once as its own pass, like the camera's front camera.
Bookmark / History / Edit / Move / Create folder: pressed through as everything else (agreed); the app is cleared at the start of every run.
app_name: the name the app shows under its icon, for the Summary sheet (the phone reports it only as a resource number).
leaves_app: By continuing, you agree to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Notice.
